newsitem.title: UK: ICI sells London property for 100 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: ICI sells London property for 100 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries said it had sold its company headquarters at Millbank in London to Prudential Corporation plc for 100 million stg.
ICI said the disposal will be accounted for in group's third quarter results and will give rise to an exceptional profit of about 20 million stg.
The chemicals group will be taking a leaseback and will pay rent of 3.8 million stg per year.
The Millbank property was built soon after ICI's formation in 1926 and covers around two acres of land.

"This sale is an important example of our commitment to make the best use of ICI's assets. The proceeds will be invested in our developing portfolio of businesses to deliver sustainable profitable growth," Alan Spall, ICI's finance director said.
